root_cause.explanation: Executing scripts/build_vanilla_backbone_eval_config.py by filename makes Python place scripts/ rather than the repository root at sys.path[0], so its absolute scripts.* import cannot resolve. Unit tests imported the file as a package and therefore did not exercise this entrypoint mode.

fix.strategy: minimal repository-root sys.path bootstrap only when __package__ is empty

impact.note: Failure occurred before vanilla config resolution and before any model load or metric calculation. The successful OEA resolved config is preserved as attempt evidence.
